name: KoBBQ
description: KoBBQ is a Korean bias benchmark dataset for question answering that adapts the BBQ benchmark to Korean cultural contexts. It includes 268 templates and 76,048 samples across 12 categories of social bias, enabling evaluation of social biases in language models specific to Korean culture.
reputation: KoBBQ is a relatively new but well-cited Korean adaptation of BBQ that is used in research on social bias evaluation for Korean-language models.
notes: Includes a framework for cultural adaptation of bias benchmarks and adds Korean-specific bias categories.
